targets.query: AppSpans | where DependencyName == 'ThirdPartyAPI' | summarize p95=percentile(DependencyLatencyMs,95) by bin(Timestamp,1m) | order by Timestamp asc
AppExceptions | where DependencyName == 'ThirdPartyAPI' | summarize c=count() by bin(Timestamp,1m), ExceptionType | order by Timestamp asc

AppSpans | where DependencyName == 'ThirdPartyAPI' and (DependencyStatusCode >= 400 or isnotempty(ErrorType)) | top 100 by Timestamp desc | project Timestamp, DependencyEndpoint, DependencyStatusCode, ErrorType, ErrorMessage, CorrelationId, TraceId, Pod
